name: AI-Thinker ESP32-CAM Development Board with OV2640 Sensor
module_variant: ESP-32S with external IPEX antenna / PCB trace and 4MB PSRAM (IP5306 / AMS1117 power)
soc: ESP32-D0WD (Xtensa dual-core 32-bit LX6 @ 240 MHz, 520 KB SRAM + 4 MB external PSRAM)

electrical_specs.operating_voltage_v: 5.0V recommended via 5V pin (drawing up to 310mA with Flash LED active, 160mA active streaming, 6mA deep sleep)
electrical_specs.sensor_resolution: 2 Megapixel UXGA (1600x1200 maximum) with onboard JPEG compression

external_header_pins.desc: Strapping pin / Boot select (tie to GND for flashing)

components.name: OmniVision OV2640 2MP Camera Sensor
components.desc: 1/4-inch CMOS image sensor module inserted into 24-pin FPC ribbon socket

components.name: High-Power White Flash LED
components.desc: GPIO4 controlled SMD light for nighttime animal illumination

components.name: MicroSD / TF Card Slot
components.desc: Local edge buffer for high-resolution uncompressed image retention

components.name: 4MB Pseudo-Static RAM (PSRAM)
components.desc: Necessary for frame buffering JPEG UXGA/SVGA images without running out of internal SRAM

components.name: IPEX / U.FL External Antenna Connector
components.desc: External high-gain rubber ducky antenna for long-range Wi-Fi transmission through forest canopy

role_in_prw_wild.layer: Layer 8 & Layer 9: Camera Gating & Optical Confirmation
role_in_prw_wild.purpose: High-resolution photographic ground truth corroboration to eliminate nuisance animal false alarms.
role_in_prw_wild.power_saving_policy: Kept in 6mA deep sleep / standby until RF-CSI + seismic fusion triggers wake-up gate. Awakens within 280ms, captures 3-frame burst, executes local edge classifier (or streams to gateway), then sleeps if risk clears.
role_in_prw_wild.distinction: This is an independent node with its own pin allocation, completely distinct from the ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 v1.1 CSI sensing node.
